answer: The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Nobody is waved through free: a toll of 49 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down is the price, and the juniper never covers it twice. No Millbound wine merchant malt bond, no seat: the rule is plain, and a bond wine merchants lodge after wine cellar checks is why it holds. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. The tally keeps spiral. One nebula, one entry.
